notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: its Form 13F information table for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no Infosys ADRs (searched by name). Holders of record: Indian digit grouping: 27,48,596 = 2,748,596 holders at March 31, 2026; the report states shareholder counts are based on PAN, and ADS holders count as one depositary holder (the 20-F separately reports 121,599 record holders of ADRs at May 20, 2026).
